Package arcade.core.util

Class Graph.Node

java.lang.Object
arcade.core.util.Graph.Node
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Graph.Node>
Direct Known Subclasses:
PatchComponentSitesGraph.SiteNode
Enclosing class:

public static class Graph.Node extends Object implements Comparable<Graph.Node>
Nested class representing a graph node.

The node tracks its corresponding position in the lattice.
